sections.body: The day resolved as relief rather than a directional break. Volatility strengthened its downtrend — VIXCLS was the widest mover against its own median, and a sub-15 print corroborates the jobs-as-all-clear read; watch whether it holds under 15 next week. Semis rotated violently under a flat index — Memory and Foundry up, Cyber and Software down — a single-week churn worth watching for follow-through into next week rather than a settled trend.
